articles.summary: The RealReal (Nasdaq: REAL), the world's largest online marketplace for authenticated luxury resale, today announced the opening of its newest Los Angeles-area store at 230 S Brand Blvd, Glendale, CA on October 1, 2026 . The new location expands The RealReal's Southern California presence and brings its full-service luxury consignment and shopping experience to a new community of buyers and consignors across Glendale and the greater Los Angeles area. The new store combines The RealReal's industry-leading authentication expertise with personalized consignment services and a curated shopping experience. Customers can consign, shop and discover authenticated luxury across women's and men's fashion, handbags, fine jewelry, watches and accessories. Glendale was a natural choice for The RealReal's newest Los Angeles-area location. Located just outside Downtown Los Angeles and Hollywood, the destination has established itself as one of Southern California's leading fashion and lifestyle
articles.title: The RealReal Expands Los Angeles Presence with New Glendale Store
